sources.title: Sierra Leone Immigration Department
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Sierra Leone Immigration Department homepage identifies evisa.sl as its Official Portal and directs applicants to apply there. It authenticates the linked service but does not itself identify a nationality-specific issuance point.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Apply eVisa Official Portal Apply online via the official Sierra Leone eVisa portal.

sources.title: Government of Sierra Leone eVisa system: live terms
sources.publisher: Ministry of Internal Affairs, Republic of Sierra Leone
sources.officialityEvidence: The SLID-authenticated live eVisa service identifies the Ministry of Internal Affairs as operator. Its current English terms describe electronic delivery after acceptance, but that statement conflicts with the same service's airport-or-border issuance FAQ.
sources.supportingExcerpt: If your eVisa application is accepted, we will be sending you the eVisa as an email attachment.

sources.title: Government of Sierra Leone eVisa system: live payment FAQ
sources.publisher: Ministry of Internal Affairs, Republic of Sierra Leone
sources.officialityEvidence: The same SLID-authenticated live eVisa service says the visa is issued on arrival at an airport or border after approval. It directly conflicts with the live terms' emailed-eVisa wording, so neither result is selected without a current pair-specific authority.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Once your visa application has been approved, you'll be issued your Visa upon arrival at the airport or border.
